title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the General Services Department report dated May 29, 2025, included as an attachment to…
text:
[Council File 18-0534-S1; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the General Services Department report dated May 29, 2025, included as an attachment to the Municipal Facilities Committee report dated June 3, 2025, regarding the Community Investment Department taking the CRA/LA Excess Non-Housing Bond Proceeds project monitoring role for the Hollywood Walk of Fame Public Amenities Project.
Recommendation for Council action:
ADD the language in italics contained in the Motion to the Government Operations Committee Report approved by Council on June 25, 2025, attached to the Council file.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 9, 2026); Council action final

summary: Council action to have the Community Investment Department, rather than another office, oversee the bond-funded Hollywood Walk of Fame public amenities project.

locations.text: Hollywood Walk of Fame, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: amend project monitoring role for bond-funded project
